title: Loomtide Tier-2 VLM Review Findings (ADVISORY)
description: The strict review-findings shape a fresh-context VLM reviewer subagent emits when comparing rendered key frames against the design mock + acceptance contract. This tier is ADVISORY for the Tier-1 `status`: it is reported under the SEPARATE `reviewFindings` key of the verify report and is NOT folded into the Tier-1 pass/fail. HOWEVER, the verify-2d-game definition-of-done REQUIRES this review to run against PLAY-MODE frames (HUD visible) and every perceptual `fail` to be resolved (fix → re-verify) or justified in writing before handover. No free-form verdict is permitted — only criteria scored pass|warn|fail with a one-line reason and the evidence frame it is based on.

reference.description: What the review compared the frames AGAINST (plan §P0.1). The hero-shot fidelity predicate in `loomtide doneness` requires `heroShotSha256` to equal the FROZEN hero-shot hash recorded in the verdict's `designTarget.pngSha256`; this is the machine-checkable proof the review judged the hero-shot IMAGE rather than contract attributes (`references hero-shot.png:false` was the RUN-1 tell that this was missing).

heroShot.description: Path to the frozen hero-shot the reviewers were given (e.g. `.loomtide/design/hero-shot.png`).

heroShotSha256.description: sha256 (hex) of the hero-shot bytes the reviewers compared against. Must match the verdict's `designTarget.pngSha256` for `doneness` to certify a design-targeted build.

independence.description: Attestation that this review was an INDEPENDENT, multi-reviewer pass — NOT the build agent grading itself (plan §P0.3). `doneness` refuses to certify a design-targeted build unless `independent` is true and `reviewerCount` >= 2. The CLI cannot prove fresh-context independence; it enforces that the review at least carries the >=2-reviewer attestation, and the command prose (vlm-review.md / build.md) makes the agent actually spawn fresh-context reviewers.

independent.description: True when the reviewers did NOT author the build (fresh context, no build knowledge).

reviewerCount.description: Number of independent reviewers whose flags were unioned into these findings. doneness requires >=2.

frames.description: The captured key frames the review is based on (spawn, mid-action moment, win/end, etc.). Each frame is referenced by `id` from a criterion's `evidenceFrame`.

path.description: Artifact path to the captured PNG (no base64 blobs — store the file, reference it).

label.description: Optional human label, e.g. "Player at spawn, frame 0".

criteria.description: The advisory criteria requested by the game contract or the default generic rubric. Each is scored independently. Three groups: (A) design-fidelity checks (composition/palette/font/juice/end-state/hazard/collectible path/parallax) and (B) perceptual long-tail checks — `hud-crispness`, `props-grounded`, `platform-edge-to-edge`, `backdrop-seamless`, `palette-match`, `composition-match`, `rendering-artifacts` — the catch-all for the 'looks wrong' issues the deterministic gates miss; and (C) the HERO-SHOT STRUCTURAL FIDELITY checks — `composition-match`, `parallax-present`, `platform-tiers`, `element-placement-arc` — judged against the frozen hero-shot IMAGE (plan §P0.1/P0.2). Group C is special: for a design-targeted build, `loomtide doneness` REFUSES to certify unless every group-C criterion is present and `pass`. These are not advisory — they are the moat (a flat-background / flat-level build that diverges from the hero shot cannot be certified, regardless of green Tier-1 gates). Every group-B `fail` MUST be resolved (fix the build → re-verify) or explicitly justified in writing before handover — see `vlm-review.md`.

id.description: The criterion id. One of the game-contract or default advisory rubric criteria. Group A = design fidelity; group B (`hud-crispness` … `rendering-artifacts`) = the perceptual long-tail checks, each comparing the PLAY-MODE frame to the mock/contract.

status.description: pass = matches the mock/contract; warn = a soft deviation worth surfacing; fail = a clear mismatch. ADVISORY — never gates the build.

reason.description: A SINGLE concise line citing the specific observation (e.g. "score color does not match the contract palette"). No multi-paragraph prose.

evidenceFrame.description: The `frames[].id` this judgement is based on. Required in practice so a human can re-check the same frame; allowed to be omitted only for a criterion that spans all frames.

summary.description: A single short advisory summary line. Not a verdict; the Tier-1 gates decide pass/fail.
